column1: # UNGRADABLE.tsv -- jcon_tests: shipped programs that CANNOT be graded as standalone programs, each named with
# the reason MEASURED against the oracle. THE PACKAGE LOCKDOWN (Lon 2026-09-06).
# Columns: path <TAB> REASON <TAB> evidence (the oracle's own words + how it was measured).
# ORACLE: icont/iconx 9.5.25a, /home/resources/icon-master/bin. CONTRACT: upstream tests/general/Test-icon --
#   icont -s NAME.icn ; ./NAME < NAME.dat-if-present-else-/dev/null > out 2>&1 ; diff NAME.std out
# Determinism is two runs ONE SECOND APART, never back-to-back (a back-to-back pair cannot detect clock dependence).
# ⛔ These stay IN the denominator (POPULATION LAW 2026-09-04): shipped, never graded, never counted as passed.
# ⛔⭐ SUPERSEDES corpus a1623cf8f, which landed this same file concurrently with all TEN rows as
#    NO-ORACLE-SHIPPED -- "upstream ships no link1.std, so ... ungradable against its own oracle, not work
#    owed". Nine of those ten are right in substance. link1.icn is NOT: it is GRADABLE, measured against the
#    live oracle (two-file compile + args `a b c` -> "{{ a }}/{{ b }}/{{ c }}", deterministic), and it has
#    moved to UNGRADED.tsv. ⭐ "We hold no ref" is the SYMPTOM; the lockdown asks for the oracle's own
#    REASON, and the two are only the same when the oracle has actually been asked. Declaring the symptom
#    "not work owed" retires a live debt with a receipt saying it was checked -- the same class seat03 found
#    in csnobol4 the same day (preload1/preload2 assumed ungradable, in fact gradable: a wiring gap).
# ⛔ This file replaces the generic "(no .std shipped upstream)" string the runner used to print: that named the
#    SYMPTOM (we hold no ref) where the lockdown requires the ORACLE'S OWN REASON. link1.icn was in that same
#    undifferentiated gap and is in fact GRADABLE -- it is in UNGRADED.tsv, not here.

column3: Graded by a PREPROCESSOR-ONLY contract, not by running it: tpp.std is jcon PREPROCESSOR TEXT (its first line is `#line 0 "tpp.icn"`), not program output, so the vendored .std is not a run-and-diff oracle for this file at all; the body is deliberately-invalid Icon (`abc 11`, `bad #lines`). Upstream grades it as `icont -E tpp.icn tpp9.icn` against tpp.ok, and tpp.ok is not vendored here. A standalone oracle run yields a diagnostic stream, not output -- File a.b.c; Line 12 # "abc": invalid declaration File bad #lines; Line 13 # $line: too many arguments File bad
